summary: Tested iter315b inline marketing-budget pill + iter315c GPC presets. Backend regression (14/14 iter315 tests) all green. CRITICAL frontend bug confirmed: after saving a budget the pill label does NOT refresh to '$ Budget · $X/mo' and the popover does NOT close, because ProductEditCard.jsx line 443 calls `onBudgetChanged?.()` which is an undeclared identifier (not destructured from props, not in scope). Optional chaining does NOT catch ReferenceError — the call throws, jumps to the catch block which then surfaces 'Save failed' to the user even though the PUT /api/maker/listing-budgets/{slug} returned 200 and the row was persisted. GPC combobox surfaces the new presets for wedding/outdoor/seasonal/cutting board/license plate/pet (3-13 matches each), but the keyword 'automotive' returns 0 matches — the new automotive entries use the literal taxonomy text 'Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle …', so the word 'automotive' never appears.

ui_bugs.issue: Budget save flow throws ReferenceError on `onBudgetChanged?.()` (line 443). Optional chaining does NOT mask a ReferenceError on an undeclared identifier — the call throws, the try/catch catches it, the user sees toast.error 'Save failed' even though PUT returned 200 and DB row was persisted. As side-effects: (a) pill label stays at '$ SET MARKETING BUDGET' instead of updating to '$ Budget · $20/mo'; (b) setBudgetOpen(false) on line 445 never runs so the popover stays open in the unhappy path. Fix: either destructure `onBudgetChanged` from props in line 13 (and have ProductsList pass it down to re-fetch budgets without a full product refetch), OR simply drop the `onBudgetChanged?.()` call and rely on `onChanged?.()` which IS destructured and triggers a product/budget refetch upstream.

GPC combobox search for keyword 'automotive' returns 0 results. The automotive taxonomy entries use the literal Google taxonomy text 'Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle …' — the word 'automotive' never appears in any preset string, so makers typing the more common consumer term won't surface license plate frames / emblems / interior fittings entries. Fix: either add the word 'automotive' as a search alias on those entries or append parenthetical 'Automotive' synonyms in the visible label.

integration_issues.flow: Listings tab → Set marketing budget pill → Save
integration_issues.issue: PUT /api/maker/listing-budgets/{slug} returns 200 and persists, but the optimistic UI refresh fails because of the ReferenceError described above. Pill label stays stale until full page reload.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix ReferenceError in ProductEditCard.jsx line 443 — drop `onBudgetChanged?.()` (or destructure it from props). Currently every budget save shows a misleading 'Save failed' toast even when the backend succeeds.
MEDIUM: Add 'automotive' synonym to the Vehicles & Parts GPC presets (or expose a search-alias array) so makers searching for the consumer term find the new license-plate / emblem / interior entries.
Verify after fix: pill label updates to '$ Budget · $20/mo' without page reload, popover closes, and toast says 'Budget set to $20/mo.'
critical_code_review_comments: ProductEditCard.jsx line 443 uses optional chaining on an undeclared identifier — common React gotcha; optional chaining ONLY guards null/undefined, NOT ReferenceError. Lint should have caught this (ESLint no-undef). Suggest enabling no-undef in the frontend lint config to prevent recurrence.
ProductEditCard.jsx is 760+ lines — well above the 700-line guideline. The ActionPill, OverflowMenu, IndexingBadge, and the budget popover should be extracted into their own files.
seed_data_creation: None — tested against existing 6 published listings (12 total cards, 6 with budget pills as designed; drafts correctly hide the pill).
context_for_next_testing_agent: After E1 fixes line 443, re-run a UI smoke: (1) open /maker/dashboard?tab=listings as iron-and-oak, (2) click any '$ SET MARKETING BUDGET' pill, (3) enter $20, click Save Budget, (4) assert pill label changes to '$ Budget · $20/mo' WITHOUT reloading, (5) re-open pill, enter $0, save → assert label reverts to '$ SET MARKETING BUDGET'. Backend persistence already verified — only UI optimistic update needs revalidation.
rca of the issue: PUT /api/maker/listing-budgets/test-iter21-bg-4213c8 returned 200 and the row was upserted in MongoDB (confirmed via Network panel). But the post-save flow in ProductEditCard.jsx (lines 422-450) does: `await upsertListingBudget(...)` → `toast.success(...)` → `onBudgetChanged?.()` ← THROWS ReferenceError because `onBudgetChanged` is not declared anywhere in the component (not in props destructure at line 13, not as a useState, nothing). The optional-chaining operator does NOT prevent ReferenceError for undeclared identifiers — it only short-circuits when the value is null/undefined. The thrown error is caught by the surrounding try/catch (line 446) which fires `toast.error('Save failed')` and skips `setBudgetOpen(false)`. Net effect: backend succeeds, user sees a fake failure toast, pill label stays stale, popover stays open. Fix is one line: either (a) destructure `onBudgetChanged` from props and have ProductsList pass it down, or simpler (b) delete line 443 and rely on `onChanged?.()` (line 444) which is already destructured and triggers a parent refetch including budgets.
